items.title: Free Leonard Peltier
items.overview: Leonard Peltier, an activist jailed for decades after a disputed conviction, faces his twilight years as a new generation fights for his release from prison before it's too late.

items.title: Street Fighter
items.overview: 1993-ban a külön utakon járó harcosok, Ryu (Andrew Koji) és Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) ismét küzdelembe keverednek, amikor a titokzatos Chun-Li (Callina Liang) beszervezi őket a következő World Warrior Tournamentre: egy brutális összecsapásra. De a háttérben egy halálos összeesküvés húzódik, amely arra kényszeríti őket, hogy szembenézzenek egymással és múltjuk démonaival.  (Bolla Eszter)R3

items.title: Iron Boy
items.overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

items.title: Minotaur
items.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

items.title: My Happy End
items.overview: Minden kutya kergeti a farkát, de miután egyszer az egyik sikeresen el is kapja, örökre megváltozik az élete, és közben egy új legjobb barátot is szerez.

items.title: You Can See Everything
items.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

items.title: A mesterterv
items.overview: Amikor egy legendás tolvaj a Mona Lisára vet szemet, két fiatalt toboroz magának segítségül - Chiarát, egy olasz kiberbűnözés-szakértőt, és Jayt, egy francia robbanószer-szakértőt -, majd elárulná, hogy mindkettejüknek ő az apja. A kaotikus találkozás közben az új családtagoknak meg kell tanulniuk együttműködni, és nem megölni egymást, hogy esélyük legyen az évszázad rablásának végrehajtására.

items.title: Wildwood - A tiltott vadon
items.overview: Prue és osztálytársa, Curtis egy tiltott, varázslatos erdőbe téved, amelyet elbűvölt lények, hűséges szövetségesek és félelmetes ellenfelek népesítenek be. Kétségbeesett küldetésre indulnak, hogy kiszabadítsák Prue elrabolt kisöccsét, Macet a varjak fogságából, akiket egy Alexandra nevű, titokzatos nő vezet. (Csillag Lajos)

items.title: The man formerly known as Maxwell Milk
items.overview: Maxwell details his dairy journey as he mutates into someone unrecognizable.

items.title: Quick Fix
items.overview: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

items.title: Kashpirovsky. Under the Spell
items.overview: The film tells the remarkable story of Dr Anatoly Kashpirovsky, who, at the height of his career, claimed to anaesthetise three women remotely for major surgery through the sheer force of his persuasion. His televised healing séances, broadcast across the Soviet bloc, broke viewing records, reaching hundreds of millions of people. Loved by his followers and despised by his enemies, Kashpirovsky became an unlikely symbol of a world undergoing radical political transformation.

items.title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
items.overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

items.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
items.overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

items.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
items.overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.
